weekOverview.focus: Full Body — Squat Focus + Knee Valgus

baselineNotes.label: ALST At-Risk
baselineNotes.body: ALST index 5.3 kg/m² is below the 5.5 EWGSOP2 sarcopenia threshold. Protein escalated to 2.0–2.2 g/kg/day; creatine 3–5g daily strongly indicated.

baselineNotes.label: Styku Asymmetry
baselineNotes.body: Left arm (6.4 vs 6.9 lbs) and left leg (12.1 vs 12.6 lbs) LST are lower on both segments — gap at alert threshold. Left leads all unilateral work this block.

baselineNotes.label: Corrective Priority
baselineNotes.body: Right knee valgus on squat descent — banded squat and TKE precede every squat session.

days.title: DAY 1 — MONDAY
days.subtitle: Full Body — Squat Focus + Knee Valgus
days.intensityPara: 70% day — moderate strength, no peak CNS demand. Full range of motion, controlled tempo.
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, band pull-aparts x15, bodyweight squats x10, lateral band walks x10/side
days.iconsNote: Watch the right knee on squat descent — cue 'push the knee out' every set.

blocks.title: Corrective
blocks.intro: Knee valgus correctives before any loaded squat pattern.

exercises.name: Banded Squat
exercises.cue: Push knees out against the band.

blocks.title: Primary Strength
blocks.intro: Working sets at 70% — 2 RIR on all sets.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Brace, knees track over toes, full depth.

exercises.name: Single-Arm DB Row
exercises.cue: Lead with left arm — weaker side.

days.title: DAY 2 — WEDNESDAY
days.subtitle: Posterior Chain — Deadlift Focus
days.intensityPara: 80% day — primary strength. Last 1-2 reps hard but achievable.
days.warmUp: 5 min row, glute bridges x15, RDL with dowel x10
days.iconsNote: Add 5 lbs to deadlift if last week was clean at 1-2 RIR.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes hard at the top.

exercises.name: Hex Bar Deadlift
exercises.cue: Push floor away, brace before every rep.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.cue: Lead with left leg — weaker side.

days.title: DAY 3 — FRIDAY
days.subtitle: Upper Body — Technique
days.descriptor: TECHNIQUE DAY · LIGHTER LOADS · FULL ATTENTION TO FORM
days.intensityPara: 60% day — technique focus. Form over load, no PRs. Bank clean movement patterns.
days.warmUp: 5 min row, band pull-aparts x15, arm circles x10/direction, scap push-ups x10
days.coolDown: Doorway chest stretch 60s/side, cross-body shoulder stretch 30s/side
days.iconsNote: Technique day — dial in OHP bar path before loading next block. Hit protein target daily to support ALST recovery.

blocks.title: Primary Strength
blocks.intro: Working sets at 60% — 3+ RIR, technique focus.

summary.milestones4wk: Right knee tracks cleanly through full squat depth without banded cue. Deadlift +10 lbs.
summary.milestones8wk: Full Styku rescan. ALST index should move toward 5.5+. L/R LST gap should narrow.
summary.rescanNote: Schedule Styku rescan at week 8 to confirm ALST trend and asymmetry reduction.
